title: An Efficient Routing Optimization Framework for Silicon-Based Spin-Qubit Devices
problem: Silicon-based spin-qubit routing has unique constraints that make existing qubit routing methods from other quantum platforms ineffective.
motivation: Silicon spin-qubits offer promising scalability to thousands of qubits with small area, but lack specialized optimization methods.
method: Novel routing method using Dijkstra's algorithm and breadth-first search with bit-vector representation for efficient routing region overlap checking.
key_novelty: Specialized routing method tailored to silicon spin-qubit constraints addressing factors overlooked by existing approaches.
contributions: High-quality routing on large benchmarks (up to 1617 qubits, 700k gates)

metrics.other: operation overhead: 29% reduction, depth overhead: 7% reduction

limitations: Limited to silicon spin-qubit technology; applicability to other quantum platforms unclear.
primary_theme: Efficient routing for silicon spin-qubit devices
